points.quote: The University does not have a blanket restriction on the use of AI tools but does expect the fundamental principle that all work you submit must be your own.
points.gist: There is no blanket restriction on AI tools, but all work you submit must be your own.

points.quote: Assignments produced wholly or partly using AI tools and submitted as your own work without acknowledgement will be treated as academic misconduct.
points.gist: Assignments produced wholly or partly with AI and submitted as your own without acknowledgement will be treated as academic misconduct.

points.quote: Your tutors will provide clear guidance on whether AI tools can or cannot be used in a particular assignment.
points.gist: Tutors will give clear guidance on whether AI tools can be used in a particular assignment.

points.quote: The Use of Generative AI Tools Declaration Form can be attached to your assignment to show when you have used a generative AI tool. You should include the details of the AI tool used, how you have used it and your search prompts.
points.gist: A declaration form can be attached to an assignment; include the tool used, how it was used and your search prompts.

points.quote: The Academic Practice AI Checklist ensures that you have followed good academic practice in any use of GenAI before submitting your work.
points.gist: The Academic Practice AI Checklist ensures you have followed good academic practice in any GenAI use before submitting.

points.quote: it is important that in an academic context it is used ethically and transparently; it must not be used to replace your own work and opinion.
points.gist: In an academic context AI must be used ethically and transparently and must not replace your own work and opinion.

points.quote: over reliance can impact on your ability to develop the key skills such as critical thinking, analysis and writing which will be crucial to your success after your studies.
points.gist: Over reliance can impact your ability to develop critical thinking, analysis and writing skills.

points.quote: Studiosity provides 24/7 writing support including feedback on a piece of writing.
points.gist: Studiosity provides 24/7 writing support including feedback on a piece of writing.

points.quote: Research Assistant on OneSearch allows you to search the library’s resources using this AI tool which allows you to search using natural language as a starting point to your research.
points.gist: Research Assistant on OneSearch lets you search the library's resources in natural language as a starting point.

points.quote: A short conversation of 20-50 questions and answers on ChatGPT uses half a litre of fresh water
points.gist: A short ChatGPT conversation of 20-50 questions and answers uses half a litre of fresh water.

points.quote: You may want to consider using alternatives such as Ecosia a search engine and AI chat tool used by 20 million people worldwide which plants trees and invests in dedicated climate action.
points.gist: You may want to consider alternatives such as Ecosia, a search engine and AI chat tool that plants trees.

points.quote: You can also sign up to Grammarly for free.
points.gist: You can sign up to Grammarly for free.
